results.title: NBA Fans Question 76ers’ Favorable Schedule After LeBron James Arrival
results.description: The Philadelphia 76ers will enter the 2026-27 season with one of the NBA’s most star-studded and talented rosters. But a surprisingly favorable schedule has some fans questioning whether the league is making life easier for LeBron James and his new team.
